input.command: $os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; "free MB: {0} of {1}" -f [math]::Round($os.FreePhysicalMemory/1024), [math]::Round($os.TotalVisibleMemorySize/1024); Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 6 Name,Id,@{n='MB';e={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB)}} | Format-Table -HideTableHeaders
